items.title: 3 Cash-Producing Stocks That Concern Us

items.title: Paramount Skydance launches $7.5B leveraged loan for Warner Bros Discovery acquisition
items.summary: A Citi-led arranger group has launched a $7.5 billion-equivalent cross-border term loan B split between a $6.5 billion US dollar tranche and a $1 billion-equivalent euro tranche as part of the debt financing package supporting the acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (Nasdaq: WBD) by Paramount Skydance Corp. (Nasdaq: PSKY), according to sources. Commitments to the deal are due on Wednesday, Sept. 30, by noon ET (5 p.m. BST) for the dollar portion and 9 a.m. ET (2 p.m. BST) for the euros. Price

items.title: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) Lines Up $7.5 Billion Loan For Its Acquisition
items.summary: On 23 September 2026, Paramount Skydance (NasdaqGS:PSKY) began syndicating a new US$7.5b loan to help fund its planned Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition. The media group also outlined plans to raise more than US$44b in secured debt tied to the proposed transaction. Management framed the fresh financing as a material step forward in deal execution, including new debt commitments and updated transaction milestones.
